info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Details API
info.description: The Settlement Details API provides access to specific information regarding settlements identified by their unique settlement IDs. This endpoint allows users, such as financial analysts and accounting software developers, to retrieve detailed status and transaction data related to completed settlements. Consumers can utilize this API for reporting, reconciliation, or auditing purposes. By employing this resource, organizations can enhance their understanding of settlement transactions and improve financial transparency.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific settlement by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of a specific settlement using its unique identifier. It provides all relevant information associated with the settlement, facilitating further processing or display in applications.
